curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Ultraviolet protect the nine-year-old boy as the human government pursues him over a threat it believes he poses?
curatedMovie.description: In a late-21st-century civil conflict, an infected woman protects a nine-year-old boy the human government has marked for death.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful sci-fi action packed with stylized kinetic combat.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Kurt Wimmer delivers a kinetic, high-velocity sci-fi thriller driven by modified superhuman combat and relentless dystopian stakes.
